solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, answers clash); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Screws handle on board

indicators.note: to be on board is to be aboard a ship, so the handle sits inside the ship abbreviation

blocks.note: a haft is the handle of a knife or tool
SS, steamship, is the crossword's usual vessel to be on board

explanation.surface: Someone fixing a handle onto a plank with screws.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' means placed inside SS, the steamship abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: To shaft someone is slang for cheating or swindling them, just as screwing them is.

clue.text: Joint of beef – not Welsh

indicators.note: 'not Welsh' asks for the Welsh abbreviation to be left out of the word

blocks.note: to beef is to complain, to whinge
W is the abbreviation for Welsh

explanation.surface: A cut of beef that is not of Welsh origin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Joint of beef' reads as one butcher's phrase, but 'Joint' is the definition and 'beef' is a verb, to complain.
explanation.definitionFit: A hinge is a movable joint, like the one in a door or the knee.

clue.text: African politicians supporting French currency

indicators.note: in a down answer, what supports another part sits beneath it, so it comes second

blocks.note: FR is the abbreviation for French
the African National Congress, South Africa's governing party

explanation.surface: A South African party backing a French money policy.
explanation.definitionFit: The franc was France's unit of money before the euro and is still used in several countries.

clue.text: High class officer seen in hospital with a concubine

indicators.note: something seen in a place is inside it, so these letters go within the hospital

blocks.note: U denotes upper class
LT is short for lieutenant
a san is a sanatorium
taken as written

explanation.surface: A posh officer spotted in a hospital with his mistress.
explanation.walkthrough: U for upper class is a crossword convention; SAN is short for sanatorium.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultana is a wife or mistress of a sultan, so a royal harem concubine fits.

clue.text: Opening mechanism in, say, Baldrick's short trousers!

indicators.note: short means cut off at the end, so the last letter of the trousers word goes

blocks.note: a baldric is a belt or band worn over the shoulder; the setter borrows the Blackadder servant's spelling
cords are corduroy trousers

explanation.surface: Baldrick, the grubby servant in TV's Blackadder, pictured in short trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: Baldrick is the comedy character, but a baldric is a shoulder sash. A SASH CORD runs over a pulley to raise a sash window.
explanation.definitionFit: The cord and its weights let a sash window slide up and open, so it works the window's opening.

clue.text: Husbands and wives dash around Portugal and Spain at first

indicators.note: the dash word goes around, enclosing what follows it
at first points to the opening letters of the two country names

blocks.note: to dash with water is to souse, drench
first letter of the country
first letter of the country

explanation.surface: Married couples rushing about the Iberian peninsula on holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Spouses are married partners, a collective term covering both husbands and wives.

clue.text: People with hellish ruler come back with cocktail

indicators.note: to come back is to go the other way, so the pair is read from the end

blocks.note: a race is a people
Dis is the Roman god of the underworld

explanation.surface: A nation and the lord of the underworld returning with drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: Dis, also called Pluto, rules Hades in Roman myth.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidecar is a classic mixed drink of brandy, orange liqueur and lemon juice.

clue.text: Concur with Dot about leader

indicators.note: about suggests the letters are turned around and moved here and there

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Agreeing with a woman called Dot about who should lead.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchestra or band is led by its conductor, who directs the players.

clue.text: Tribe ban a revolutionary Jewish office

indicators.note: a revolution overturns things, so these letters are thrown into a new order

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A tribe outlawing a rebel who holds religious office.
explanation.definitionFit: The rabbinate is the post or office of a rabbi, the religious teacher of a Jewish congregation.

clue.text: I return grease gun after introduction of novel printing process

indicators.note: an introduction is the opening, so only the first letter of the following word is used
returning means going back the way you came, so the grease and gun words are read backwards

blocks.note: taken as written
first letter of the word
grease is a lubricant like oil
gat is old slang for a pistol

explanation.surface: Handing back a grease gun after reading the start of a novel.
explanation.walkthrough: The reversed oil and gun follow the N, as 'after' says, with I leading.
explanation.definitionFit: Intaglio is a technique in which the design is cut into a plate and ink held in the grooves is pressed onto paper.

clue.text: River expert meets with Hubble on a regular basis

indicators.note: on a regular basis means every other letter is taken from the astronomer's name

blocks.note: a dan is a grade of expertise in judo or karate, hence an expert
second, fourth and sixth letters

explanation.surface: A river specialist having regular meetings with the astronomer Edwin Hubble.
explanation.definitionFit: The Danube is a major European river flowing from Germany to the Black Sea.

clue.text: I once represented college girl within a form of art

indicators.note: to represent is to present again in a different form, so these letters are rearranged
within places the girl inside the reworked letters

blocks.note: taken as written
C is the abbreviation for college
a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: Someone recalling that they once modelled for an art class as a college student.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters of I ONCE plus C split around LASS.
explanation.definitionFit: Neoclassic art revives the styles of ancient Greece and Rome, so it is a recognised artistic style.

clue.text: University has to reject operating system

blocks.note: U is the abbreviation for university
to nix is to veto or reject

explanation.surface: A university forced to turn down a computer system.
explanation.definitionFit: Unix is a multi-user computer system first developed at Bell Labs, ancestor of Linux and macOS.

clue.text: People from a peninsular in Serbia perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps signals that the letters could be arranged some other way

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Inhabitants of a Balkan peninsula, such as those living in Serbia.
explanation.walkthrough: Serbia is on the Balkan peninsula, which makes the surface plausible, but the letters rearrange to the other peninsula's people.
explanation.definitionFit: Iberians live on the Iberian peninsula of Spain and Portugal.

clue.text: Earl will feature in Times with a revolutionary to protest

indicators.note: to feature in something is to appear inside it

blocks.note: times as in multiplication, three by four
E is the abbreviation for earl
'll is the contracted form of will
the article taken as written
Che Guevara, the archetypal revolutionary

explanation.surface: An aristocrat set to appear in The Times alongside a radical to make a protest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will' does double work as the contraction 'LL. BY for times is the multiplication sign read aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: To bellyache is informal for complaining at length, grumbling or objecting.

clue.text: Musical work featuring Lorelei?

blocks.note: surface reading: a stage show or song cycle with a character called Lorelei, such as Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
setter's reading: the Lorelei is a siren who sits singing on a cliff above the Rhine, so her song is literally music performed on a stone outcrop

explanation.walkthrough: Lorelei Lee is the heroine of the musical Gentlemen Prefer Blondes, but the legendary Lorelei sings from a rock on the Rhine.
explanation.definitionFit: A rock opera is a musical drama told through rock songs, like Tommy, and the Lorelei's singing comes from a rock.

clue.text: Tell about a dry tapping sound

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the informer word goes round the rest

blocks.note: to rat is to tell on someone, inform
taken as written
TT, teetotal, is dry

explanation.surface: Describing a dry tapping noise.
explanation.walkthrough: TT, teetotal, is the crossword's usual stand-in for dry, meaning no alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: Rat-tat imitates the sound of repeated knocking, as on a door.

clue.text: Badly hit ball from United lacking a bit of panache

indicators.note: lacking means without, so a letter is taken out of the joined word
a bit of means one small piece, the first letter of the flair word

blocks.note: spliced means joined, united
first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A footballer from Manchester United mishitting a shot without any flair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'United' looks like the football club, but it is an adjective meaning joined.
explanation.definitionFit: A golfer who sliced the ball struck it so it curved off sideways, a bad shot.

clue.text: Follow trail almost back to vehicle

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter of the trail word is dropped
back means the shortened trail word runs from right to left

blocks.note: to dog someone is to follow them
a trail is a track

explanation.surface: Following a trail most of the way back to a parked car.
explanation.definitionFit: A dogcart is a light two-wheeled horse-drawn carriage, originally with a box for dogs.

clue.text: Battle over Thailand lake is more tasteless

indicators.note: over here means covering, the battle word spanning and enclosing the rest

blocks.note: a battle is part of war
T is Thailand's international vehicle code
Lake Erie, one of North America's Great Lakes

explanation.surface: A war fought above a Thai lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Battle over' reads like the fighting has ended, but 'over' tells the battle word to cover the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Food or drink that is watery has little flavour, so something waterier is blander still.

clue.text: Expression of doubt about male sheep we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the word is judged by how it is spoken, not spelt

blocks.note: a wether is a castrated ram

explanation.surface: Someone doubtful about a ram they have been told of.
explanation.walkthrough: A wether is a castrated male sheep; the two words sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Whether introduces uncertainty, as in 'I wonder whether', the word used to raise a question.

clue.text: 21's time with Hindu queen involves Indian leader

indicators.note: to involve is to take in, so the queen word wraps around the leader
the leader of a word is its front, so only the opening letter is kept

blocks.note: T is the abbreviation for time
a ranee or rani is a Hindu queen or rajah's wife
first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A beginner's time spent with an Indian queen and an Indian leader.
explanation.walkthrough: '21' refers to the answer at 21 across, TYRO, a beginner. 'Indian leader' is not a ruler but the first letter of Indian.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyro is a novice learner, and a trainee is someone still being taught a job.

clue.text: Beginner included in duty roster

indicators.note: included in means the letters sit inside the words that follow

blocks.note: spans the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: A newcomer added to the work rota.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyro is a novice or learner, someone new to a skill.

clue.text: Actress who could make Bogart rage

indicators.note: could make means the given letters can be reworked to form something new

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A film star capable of infuriating Humphrey Bogart.
explanation.definitionFit: Greta Garbo was a Swedish-born Hollywood film star of the 1920s and 1930s.

clue.text: Notice to Liberal: wing it

blocks.note: an ad is a notice in a paper
Lib is short for Liberal

explanation.surface: An instruction to a Liberal politician to improvise.
explanation.definitionFit: To ad-lib is to improvise without preparation, which is what winging it means.

clue.text: Moves quickly to hit son

blocks.note: to belt is to hit hard
S is the abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: Someone rushing over to smack their son.
explanation.definitionFit: To belt along is informal for travelling very fast, speeding.

clue.text: Greek starter cut with cocaine – send it back with a complaint

indicators.note: a drug cut with another has that substance mixed into it, so the drug letter goes inside
sending back means the result so far is turned to run the other way

blocks.note: meze are Greek or Middle Eastern appetisers
C is slang for cocaine
taken as written

explanation.surface: A diner returning a Greek appetiser laced with cocaine, and complaining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complaint' here is the medical sense, an ailment, not a grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: Eczema is a skin condition, and a complaint can mean an illness or disorder.

clue.text: Honourable old singer in state capital

blocks.note: Hon is the standard short form
O is the abbreviation for old
Lulu is a Scottish pop singer

explanation.surface: A distinguished veteran singer performing in a state capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Lulu is a Scottish pop star famous since the 1960s for 'Shout'.
explanation.definitionFit: Honolulu is the capital city of Hawaii, the fiftieth US state.

clue.text: Terms are arranged to make a new recording

indicators.note: arranged means set in order, here a different order of the letters

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Contract terms are agreed for a fresh recording.
explanation.walkthrough: 'are' is both part of the indicator phrase and fodder in the surface; only its letters count.
explanation.definitionFit: To remaster is to produce a fresh master copy of an old recording, often with improved sound.

clue.text: Provide relief from Kansas aunt's employer

blocks.note: Auntie Em is Dorothy's aunt in Kansas in The Wizard of Oz
a boss is an employer

explanation.surface: Seeking help from the man who employs your Kansas aunt.
explanation.definitionFit: Embossing raises a design so it stands out from the surface, which is relief in the art sense.
